name: Delicious Stuffed Tofu with Minced Meat
desc: A savory tofu dish stuffed with a succulent meat filling. Four golden pieces sit neatly on a wide, gold-rimmed bone china plate. Steam rises in soft, fragrant curls, carrying an aroma that stirs the appetite at once. The tofu is finished in only a few bites, and the amber sauce left behind is too delicious to leave untouched — made to be poured over rice.

value.text: Delicious Stuffed Tofu with Minced Meat
